text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I give my full recommendation, Kris S!! As 
our "Special Ambassador Plenipotentiary 
for Absolute Morals Defense"!!
choice_data_list:
M-Morals Absolute Defense... Special 
Ambassador Plenipotentiary?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"You're the linchpin of our upcoming 
discipline campaign! Basically, a role 
model for the entire student body!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After all, Kris S has im-pecc-a-ble 
conduct and is a model student, sir! Right 
person for the right job, sir!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...The academy's—public morals—... I do 
not feel... they require correction, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Raising the... order level on academy 
grounds... will also help... Rudolf and 
the student council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I accept.

And so—the exploits of the Special 
Plenipotentiary Ambassador of Absolute 
Public Morals Defense, Symboli Kris S, 
began.

text_block_list.name: Slovenly Student
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ribbon's a little loose. Eh, 
whatever. Good enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Wait. Admonition.

text_block_list.name: Slovenly Student
text_block_list.text:
Gah?! The Ambassador Plenipotentiary for 
Absolute Morals Defense?! I-I'm so, so 
sorryyy!! I'll never do it againnn!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't pointed it out yet... but do 
you already see the problem?

text_block_list.name: Former Slacker Student
text_block_list.text:
Y-YES! I understand everything now! I 
understand the entire universe!

...Before even giving a warning, just by 
approaching, everyone straightened up. 
Symboli Kris S carried out her duties as 
an overwhelming role model—

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Student
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph! I'll take class when I feel like 
takin' it! Act all high and mighty with 
me, and I'll reach through your ear and 
rattle your teeth!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ Say that――one more time.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Student
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah!? What's that now?! Y-You pickin' 
a fight with me!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Did it not get through to you? Say it—one 
more time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“Shoving your hand into my ear and making 
my teeth chatter”... Just what... does 
that mean?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Student
text_block_list.text:
"...T-The meaning is... That I'll get 
serious starting today!! I am so, so 
sorryyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Ah... ...Japanese is... difficult.

Even after that, Symboli Kris S's role 
model activities continued, until finally—

text_block_list.name: Former Slacker Student
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!? H-Her Excellency, the Special 
Ambassador Plenipotentiary for the 
Absolute Defense of Public Morals!? 
Everyone, salute!!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: A-As you wish!
choice_data_list:
...You're practically a whole new person, 
in more ways than one.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...!! I am! Super deeply moved right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Behold, the pinnacle of public morals!! 
Kris S is truly the living embodiment of 
discipline!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No. I did――nothing. ――Everyone was――a 
model student from the start.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—There was... no need to instruct them. 
Everyone was—polite and well-behaved.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The role model's... duty too—whoever it 
was— would surely have fulfilled it... 
splendidly."

text_block_list.name: Former Slacker Student
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your Excellency! To think you cared that 
much about us...! And yet all we ever did 
was act scared of you—

text_block_list.name: Former Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text:
P-Please forgive us! We swear we'll be 
totally, completely serious from now on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I don't really get it, but... it's 
all about "bonds"! That's so fiery! So 
passionate!!
choice_data_list:
Maybe you're well-suited for the 
Disciplinary Committee.

Maybe you should let them catch their 
breath soon...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! We definitely need 
you as an official committee member! 
Someday, I want you to be the one leading 
the committee!

text_block_list.name: Former Slacker Student
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Th-The Excellency is gaining even 
more power!?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"...That's bad! That's super bad! The mood 
at the academy is in absolute crisis!"

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine! Without troubling Your 
Excellency any further, I will strictly 
uphold public order! I'll make sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……――Good.

And so—a movement to strictly uphold 
school discipline spread across the entire 
student body.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The whole carrot-and-stick thing, right! 
Then how about a game of dodgeball?! A 
little sports to blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see—recreation, is it? —Good.

And so, to foster closer bonds, a ball 
games tournament was held during the lunch 
break, but—

text_block_list.name: Former Slacker Student
text_block_list.text:
………… I-I'd better not throw a ball at Her 
Ladyship...

Though there was an unusually tense 
atmosphere for a mere breather, the 
academy's public morals were successfully 
upheld once more.
